feeds.title: Hoʻōla Farms News
feeds.description: Ho'ola Farms serve Hawaii's military veterans, their families, and the community by providing opportunities to heal, connect, learn, grow, and thrive. Their blog is about the latest news from Ho'ola farms, achievements, farming funds, workshop updates, and more.

feeds.title: Civil Beat » Hawaii Agriculture News
feeds.description: Follow the Hawaii Agriculture News to get in-depth news about agriculture and farming in Hawaii from our independent, nonprofit newsroom serving in Honolulu, Big Island, Maui County, and Kauai. Honolulu Civil Beat is a tax-exempt news organization dedicated to cultivating an informed body of citizens, all striving to make Hawaii a better place to live.

feeds.title: Hawaii Seed Growers Network Blog
feeds.description: Hawaii Seed Growers Network sells seeds grown in Hawaii and adapted to Hawaii's many tropical microclimates climate for our home gardens. They have many options of seeds available such as beans, grains, flowers, fruits, herbs, pepper, tomatoes, and more. The network's blog gives you all the necessary information concerning seeds, farming, tips and tricks to get better at gardening, and similar topics.

feeds.title: Hawaii Magazine » Hawai Farm and Food
feeds.description: HAWAII Magazine shares stories about what makes the Islands so luring and unique to mindful travelers who love and respect this place. This inspires the readers to travel there with an open mind and heart and to seek out authentic experiences through rich and rooted storytelling in their magazine and on digital platforms. The magazine has a section for Hawaii farming that shares news about the local farming, food, and cuisine culture.

feeds.title: Kawanui Farm Blog
feeds.description: Read the Kawanui Farm Blog to learn more about how to grow, adapt and save seeds, great recipes, information on growing and harvesting, and great educational information about how to grow your own food in Hawaii. Founded in 1998, Kawanui Farm offers workshops and farm experiences for the community. They built self-reliance and sustainable organic food systems for Hawaii's home gardens. Recently, they are trying to find table grape varieties that thrive in subtropical regions.

feeds.title: Hawai'i Farm Bureau
feeds.description: The Hawaii Farm Bureau, serving as Hawaii's voice of agriculture, protects, advocates, and advances the social, economic, and educational interests of our diverse agricultural community. The articles featured on the blog are about Job opportunities, minimum wages for Hawaii farmers, Agtech conference, safety grant programs, and more farming-related information.

feeds.title: Hawaii Farm Trails Blog
feeds.description: Hawaii Farm Trails Blog is a dedicated page that covers important points for farming, such as guide to Hawaii farms with fall activities, 5 plant infusions, guide to Hawaii farms with pumpkin patches and many such interesting information. Hawaii Farm Trails are a regenerative enterprise committed to providing you with the tools to connect to Hawaii's agricultural landscape.

feeds.title: Ahualoa farm Blog
feeds.description: farmblog is a farming blog that covers the majority of agriculture, farming, and gardening-related topics. It gives us information about biochar, chickens, crops, food, potato, stuff, tea, and tools.

feeds.title: HFUU Blog
feeds.description: HFUU is composed of 15 Chapters across the Hawaiian Islands. They are represented with a seat on the Hawaii Board of Agriculture. Their mission is to advocate and create vibrant and prosperous agricultural communities for the people of Hawaii Nei. Hawaii Farmers Union United Blog covers topics such as Thoughts on the 2022 Convention, A Passion for Conservation, DOA Urged preventing Misleading Coffee Labeling, and much more interesting news.
